programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: Wu Sung, a military swordmaster, is acused of murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and a thug, and sent to exile in Meng Chou. At the prison camp, Shih En, son of the camp commander, intercedes in his favour, to spare him the humiliating 100 bamboo lashes.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take it back.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: A recently jailed martial arts master teams up with a wronged woman to take down the mans brother, a coal baron who rules a small town with an iron fist.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: Three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls journey north to masquerade as high society debutantes and make their dreams of a gold-plated walk down the aisle come true.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: 6 swordsmen, among them 2 sisters and their husbands, a lone ranger and a security guard, plot, betray and outwit each other for a load of gold.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li stars in the story of two students looking to persuade their parents to bless their marriage. The lovebirds hatch what they think is a foolproof plan: they play dead!

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: Wang Yu plays a noble martial arts student, whose master and peers are murdered by Lo Liehs bloodthirsty karate expert, and embarks on a tough training regime to avenge them.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: This story happens in an antiquated compound with various types of tenants. A properties developer contended to acquire the properties for redevelopment.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber Of Shaolin
programme.desc: An award-winning film in 1978. Liu Yu-Te escapes to Shaolin Temple, mastered the skill of 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers. Succeeded his revenge and introduced the 36th Chamber.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Three young kung-fu warriors from wildly different backgrounds: Royal Guard Lo Lieh, fleeing soldier Lo Meng, and villager Wang Yu become students of Shaolin at the same temple.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Hung escapes Shaolin after the temple is attacked by the Ching, only to be jailed with the help of Fang (also of Shoalin) who mistakes him for a bandit. Fang must now help Hung escape so they can challenge the Ching together.

programme.title: Asia-Pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon’s pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Shaw Bros and TVB stars unite for Wang Fengs ensemble epic. Trouble is brewing when a gangster plans to change the Gossip Street residents favourite hangout into a gambling den.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and she confronts him when she finds herself pregnant.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Bai Yu Lungs father mysteriously disappears one night, and for 10 years Bai searches for him in vain. Finally, he decides to head to the far northern part of the country with the hope that he can find a clue in that region.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This film showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of three girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Black Butterfly, steals from the rich and gives to the poor. In reality, she is Bao Zhu, the daughter of retired swordsman Kwan Yee. Trouble starts when a bandit gang who she has robbed come to town looking for her.

programme.title: The Amorous Lotus Pan
programme.desc: After being raped, beautiful Lotus Pan is married off to a midget who treats her like an animal. She falls for his brother, but must compete with the murderous Men Ching!

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, lovers Lily Ho and Yueh Hua meet in a casino and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: The Dream Of Red Chamber
programme.desc: The fortunes of the wealthy and influential Jia family based in the capital, and their eventual downfall. Adapted from the famous novel by Cao Xueqin.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: Acclaimed director Chu Yuan was credited for bringing mystery thriller ingredients into his atmospheric martial arts epics, and this is one of the most impressive examples

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties popstar Carrie Ku Mei plays the Little Lark in this frothy romance of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Clan Of Amazons
programme.desc: Following such hits as Killer Clans and Clans Of Intrigue, the winning team of director Chu Yuan and novelist Ku Lung reunite with revered martial art choreographers Tang Chia and Huang Pei-chi for an atmospheric, character-rich, action-packed adventure about a mysterious masked highwayman.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: The heroes pose as gun dealers and acrobats in order to get close to the bad guys so they can avenge the death of one of their brothers. In the end they lock the bad guys in a warehouse for a final battle to the death.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: In The Fantastic Magic Baby, director Chang Che weaves a wild and woolly yarn about how the legendary Monkey King and Goddess of Mercy battle and defeat the child god Hung Hai-erh then point him down the road to righteousness.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: A rich boy obsessed with martial arts encounters a mysterious man who teaches him combat skills, allowing him to win in a duel and marry his love.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: A bizarre yet beautiful fantasy, starring Lin Dai as a goddess who falls in love with a scholar. 14 years later their son seeks to unravel the mystery.

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: Cheng Tai-Nan (Kara Hui) is an honest and faithful servant of a dying patriarch who wants nothing more than to protect his vast wealth from his selfish, conniving nephew, Yung-Sheng.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: Two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and become patriotic heroes accidentally. Assisted by a warlords daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Kuo Tsing wins the hand of fair maiden Huang Yung. Almost immediately, however, clan rivalries leads to Kuo being wounded by Ouyang Feng and Huang being named new leader of the Beggar Clan.

programme.title: The Comedy Of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman.

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: The life of a determined young girl is changed when she befriends her buildings concierge, a solitary woman who is more than what she seems.

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story known as the Mekong Massacre--two Chinese commercial vessels are ambushed while traveling down the Mekong River in the waters of the Golden Triangle, one of the largest drug-manufacturing regions in the world.

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a person’s subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma…

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: The Hong Kong police hunt for a counterfeiting gang led by a mastermind known as Painter. In an effort to find Painters real identity, the police recruits artist Lee Man to assist in solving the case.

programme.title: My Best Bet
programme.desc: A gambling addict and her anti-gambling husband face relationship challenges when she must return to her old ways after criminals target her family.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A 28-year-old IT geek has only been in love once. Surprisingly, he ends up getting romantically involved with five different women this year and the one thing they have in common is that they all live in far flung areas of Hong Kong. After taking five intensive relationship courses within these 365 days, will he find “the-one”?

programme.title: The Brotherhood Of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his childhood friend Meow flee Hong Kong after discovering that Meow attempted to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, Chai becomes a key member of the triad. When he runs into Meow one day, he knows that his gang will kill Meow if they find him.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: 13 year-old Fen is uprooted from LA and moves to Taipei in early 2003. She struggles to adjust to her new life with a new school and long-separated father.

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon
programme.desc: Crippled Ho came to Hong Kong as an illegal immigrant in 1963 and ruthlessly carved an empire from the chaotic underworld of drug dealers and corrupt police that ruled the city under notorious detective Lee Rock.

programme.title: Acting Out Of Love
programme.desc: Wei Hung Jen is a struggling actor. Hui Hsin, the associate producer, must write a script for a love story so as to get a reference letter to study scriptwriting overseas. Later Jen falls for Hui.

programme.title: American Dreams In China
programme.desc: During the economic reform period in the 80s, three undergraduates are brought together by a common ambition, to live the American dream.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize.

programme.title: The Chosen One
programme.desc: Ah Jie has a special power - he can see ghosts and exorcise them. But unlike most superheroes, he has tried all ways and means to avoid using his powers to help those in need.

programme.title: From Vegas To Macau 2
programme.desc: An Interpol agent, Vincent seeks the help of the God of Gamblers, Ken in busting the mastermind of an international crime syndicate.

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Special Couple
programme.desc: Gu disguising as a couple with Jin to secure his stay in London. Everything goes well until Gu falls for his neighbour, Hermione, and Jins parents pay a surprise visit.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: An irritable elderly man joins a team rescuing stray dogs. As they work together to save abandoned animals, the groups efforts demonstrate how compassion can change lives for both humans and canines.

programme.title: The Battle At Lake Changjin 2
programme.desc: In this second battle of the war against US aggression and to aid Korea, the 7th Infantry Company is tasked to attack the Water Gate Bridge. Facing extreme weather conditions, the 7th Company risk their lives to successfully destroy the Water Gate Bridge, thereby blocking the US army’s retreat to Xingnan Port.

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: An expert locksmith is released from prison and pulled back into a world of crooked cops and small-town gangsters, despite the future he hoped to build with his ex-fiance, a detective, and their daughter.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: A pair of cops go up against an international money-trafficking cartel.

programme.title: Quan Dao: Journey Of A Boxer
programme.desc: When Xings son attempts drug trafficking to save his fathers studio but fails and is brutally beaten up, Ah Niu accepts a death combat challenge so as to help him take revenge.

programme.title: Ready O/R Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship.

programme.title: Love And Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says “yes”. Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliffs ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: The Sunny Side Of The Street
programme.desc: Hassans father has died in a car accident. A local taxi driver, Yat, then helps him flee Hong Kong. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the shocking truth about his fathers death.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: An emergency occurs on an offshore drilling rig that would cause it to capsize and sink. The Emergency Response Unit races against the clock in a chopper rescue mission amidst dangerous explosions and fire.

programme.title: The Lady Iron Chef
programme.desc: Beer girl and part-time model Ceci has terrible cooking skills. Coming from a well-off family that owns a big culinary business, wealthy SK meets Ceci in a gourmet competition held by his familys company. Despite their different backgrounds, Ceci and SK fall for each other. However, SKs dominating mother disapproves of their relationship. To win over her future mother-in-law, Ceci must beat her rival Jade in a gourmet showdown…

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol.

programme.title: Only Cloud Knows
programme.desc: This romantic drama is based on the story of a real-life couple. It follows a grieving husband as he journeys to places of significance to his beloved dead wife across their New Zealand homeland.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: Two young men become involved in a complicated crime involving antique watches.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen
programme.desc: Set in the 1980s Hong Kong, Elaine and her best friend Ying enter the entertainment industry hoping to change their fates from poverty. Ying soon becomes a popular porn star but Elaine is lost between being her true self and an actress. When show business declines after a decade, their choices lead them to two different paths in life.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kikos life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Hafizah
programme.desc: Since childhood, Hafizah ( Olivia Jensen ) has lived in an orphanage without knowing who her parents are. Many people like her simple, cheerful and tomboyish attitude. Unfortunately, on her 18th birthday, Hafizah had to leave the orphanage according to applicable regulations. Hafizahs life changed. He is invited to work at the house of Widuri ( Ade Irawan ), a rich grandmother who is known for being fierce and angry. Hafizahs outspoken attitude resulted in her often clashing with Widuri. Surya ( Ferry Salim ), Widuris son, and wife, Vani ( Cut Tari ), persuade Hafizah to feel at home working. In fact, its not only Widuri who has to be faced, but also Ryan ( Galih Ginanjar ), his grandson. Ryans reckless behavior causes them to often fight. Slowly, Hafizah learned that Ryans behavior was because his parents household was unhappy.

Join us as we take in its stunning winter sights and learn about the indigenous Ainu culture, which was influenced by the surrounding nature.

programme.title: Ukiyoe Edo-Life: Scenic Views
programme.desc: We break down a print that warps space to allow the viewer to be in 2 places at once: Shinobazu Pond, known for its lotus flowers, and the Sumida River, one of Edos busiest waterways.

programme.title: Newsroom Tokyo
programme.desc: The host presents the most important political, social and economic updates and developments from different parts of Japan.

programme.desc: Direct and in-depth. Interviews exploring the minds and motivations of the leaders, visionaries, artists and entrepreneurs who are changing our world.
